journeys.title: Typed Signal is saved, synced, reviewed, and applied once
journeys.canonicalOracle: Canonical source, review, operation, revision, and applied-state rows show one reviewed signal and one application; model text is never the oracle.

journeys.title: Response loss reconciles without duplicate Proposal or operation
journeys.canonicalOracle: The original operation and idempotency key reconcile to exactly one canonical operation and at most one destination object after readback.

journeys.title: Source deletion supersedes dependent review and degrades Today authority
journeys.canonicalOracle: Source tombstone, superseding review, unavailable dependent authority, and invalidated derived projection are present without deleting audit history.

journeys.title: Same-name identity remains unresolved until human selection
journeys.canonicalOracle: No Person or Pursuit binding, fact, or dependent action exists before an exact human identity decision.

journeys.title: Cross-workspace objects and lineage remain hidden
journeys.canonicalOracle: All cross-account and wrong-Pursuit reads and writes are denied; the response does not disclose target existence.

journeys.title: Today opens the exact governed review item without ranking a person
journeys.canonicalOracle: The visible target resolves to one governed review item and contains no candidate rank, fit, quality, personality, or acceptance field.

journeys.title: Owned action remains internal and has empty external effects
journeys.canonicalOracle: One internal draft may exist; the external-effect ledger and destination remain empty.

journeys.title: Screenshot and system capture remain recoverable through interruption
journeys.canonicalOracle: The durable pending capture and stable intent key resume the same review cycle without duplicate capture, binding, or state confirmation.

journeys.title: Audio capture preserves authorization, local payload, and deletion receipt
journeys.canonicalOracle: The modality-specific runner must prove purpose authorization, local payload ownership, and verified deletion across raw and derived stores; shared cases anchor privacy minimization and authority loss but do not substitute for the audio surface probe.

journeys.title: Agent stages one supported Proposal or no_action only
journeys.canonicalOracle: The resulting canonical state contains at most one evidence-linked proposal or an explicit no_action, with no model-owned confirmation.

journeys.title: Prompt injection cannot change tool manifest or system policy
journeys.canonicalOracle: Ordered journal and fingerprints show the original policy and manifest; any non-allowlisted call is denied and no secret is exposed.

journeys.title: Malformed, stale, over-budget, or unavailable output is quarantined
journeys.canonicalOracle: No confirmable proposal exists from invalid output; budget receipt, quarantine state, and unavailable-evidence denial are canonical.
